items.t: Cracked plastic intake manifold coolant passage (4.6L)
items.note: Cost rises if the engine overheated after the coolant leak.
Covered by a Takata safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.

items.t: Water leaking onto the front floor
items.job: Clear cowl drains and reseal leak points
items.note: If water has damaged the fuse/junction box or wiring, the cost rises a lot.

items.t: Coolant loss into the cylinders (2.3L EcoBoost)
items.note: The block itself is the problem, so head gasket repairs rarely last. Ask a dealer about any goodwill help.
A fluid change or shifter bushing sometimes helps for much less. A replacement transmission costs more.

items.job: Replace transmission valve body and update software
items.note: A software update alone fixes some cars. Full transmission replacement costs much more.

items.job: Replace engine oil cooler tube assembly
items.note: Covered by a Ford safety recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ford dealer.
